f:debug.description: ViewHelper to generate an HTML readable dump of variables or objects. The output can be navigated like a nested tree. The output will be put at the beginning of the HTML response, unless the inline attribute is set, so that the output will be placed at the specific place where it is placed inside a Fluid template.

f:format.nl2br.description: Wrapper for PHPs nl2br function. See https://www.php.net/manual/function.nl2br.php.

f:format.number.description: Formats a number with custom precision, decimal point and grouped thousands. See https://www.php.net/manual/function.number-format.php.

decimals.description: The number of digits after the decimal point

thousandsSeparator.description: The character for grouping the thousand digits

f:format.padding.description: ViewHelper to format a string to specific lengths, by using PHPs str_pad function.

padLength.description: Length of the resulting string. If the value of pad_length is negative or less than the length of the input string, no padding takes place.

padType.description: Append the padding at this site (Possible values: right,left,both. Default: right)

f:format.printf.description: A ViewHelper for formatting values with printf. Either supply an array for the arguments or a single value.

f:format.raw.description: Outputs an argument/value without any escaping. Is normally used to output an ObjectAccessor which should not be escaped, but output as-is.

f:format.stripTags.description: Removes tags from the given string (applying PHPs strip_tags() function) See https://www.php.net/manual/function.strip-tags.php.

allowedTags.description: Optional string of allowed tags as required by PHPs strip_tags() function

f:format.trim.description: This ViewHelper strips whitespace (or other characters) from the beginning and end of a string.

characters.description: Optionally, the stripped characters can also be specified using the characters parameter. Simply list all characters that you want to be stripped. With .. you can specify a range of characters.

side.description: The side to apply, must be one of this' CASE_* constants. Defaults to both application.

value.description: The string value to be trimmed. If not given, the evaluated child nodes will be used.

f:format.urlencode.description: Encodes the given string according to http://www.faqs.org/rfcs/rfc3986.html Applying PHPs rawurlencode() function. See https://www.php.net/manual/function.rawurlencode.php.

f:fragment.description: f:fragment is the counterpart of the <f:slot> ViewHelper. It allows to provide multiple HTML fragments to a component, which defines the matching named slots. f:fragment is used directly inside a component tag, nesting into other ViewHelpers is not possible.

name.description: Name of the slot that should be filled

f:groupedFor.description: Grouped loop ViewHelper. Loops through the specified values.

as.description: The name of the iteration variable

each.description: The array or \SplObjectStorage to iterated over

groupKey.description: The name of the variable to store the current group

f:if.description: This ViewHelper implements an if/else condition.

condition.description: Condition expression conforming to Fluid boolean rules

else.description: Value to be returned if the condition if not met.

then.description: Value to be returned if the condition if met.

f:image.description: ViewHelper to resize, crop or convert a given image (if required) and render the corresponding HTML tag showing the processed image.

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes. They will be added directly to the resulting HTML tag.

aria.description: Additional aria-* attributes. They will each be added with a "aria-" prefix.

base64.description: Adds the image data base64-encoded inline to the image‘s "src" attribute. Useful for FluidEmail templates.

crop.description: overrule cropping of image (setting to FALSE disables the cropping set in FileReference)

cropVariant.description: select a cropping variant, in case multiple croppings have been specified or stored in FileReference

data.description: Additional data-* attributes. They will each be added with a "data-" prefix.

height.description: height of the image. This can be a numeric value representing the fixed height of the image in pixels. But you can also perform simple calculations by adding "m" or "c" to the value. See imgResource.height in the TypoScript Reference https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/t3tsref:confval-imgresource-height for possible options.

src.description: a path to a file, a combined FAL identifier or an uid (int). If $treatIdAsReference is set, the integer is considered the uid of the sys_file_reference record. If you already got a FAL object, consider using the $image parameter instead

treatIdAsReference.description: given src argument is a sys_file_reference record

width.description: width of the image. This can be a numeric value representing the fixed width of the image in pixels. But you can also perform simple calculations by adding "m" or "c" to the value. See imgResource.width in the TypoScript Reference on https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/t3tsref:confval-imgresource-width for possible options.

f:image.srcset.description: ViewHelper to generate a list of image URLs and their corresponding srcset descriptors to be used in a srcset attribute of an or tag.

absolute.description: Force absolute URL for generated images

crop.description: Overrule cropping of image (setting to FALSE disables the cropping set in FileReference)

cropVariant.description: Select a cropping variant, in case multiple croppings have been specified or stored in FileReference

fileExtension.description: Use the specified target file extension for generated images; files will be converted if necessary

image.description: A FAL object (\TYPO3\CMS\Core\Resource\File or \TYPO3\CMS\Core\Resource\FileReference); if not specified, ViewHelper children will be used as a fallback.

referenceWidth.description: Image width that will be used as base (1x) when calculating srcset with pixel density descriptors (e. g. 2x). This is irrelevant for width descriptors.

srcset.description: Comma-separated list of width descriptors (e. g. 200w) or pixel density descriptors (e. g. 2x).

code.description: Fluid code to be rendered as if it were part of the template rendering it. Can be passed as inline argument or tag content

f:join.description: The JoinViewHelper combines elements from an array into a single string. You can specify both a general separator and a special one for the last element, which serves as the delimiter between the elements.

separatorLast.description: The separator for the last pair.

f:last.description: The LastViewHelper returns the last item of an array.

f:layout.description: With this ViewHelper, you can select a layout to be used for the current template.

name.description: Name of layout to use. If none given, "Default" is used.

f:length.description: The LengthViewHelper returns the length of a given string. Setting the character encoding is optional.

f:link.action.description: ViewHelper for creating links to Extbase actions. Tailored for Extbase plugins, uses Extbase Request and Extbase UriBuilder.

absolute.description: If set, the URI of the rendered link is absolute

addQueryString.description: If set, the current query parameters will be kept in the URL. If set to "untrusted", then ALL query parameters will be added. Be aware, that this might lead to problems when the generated link is cached.

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes. They will be added directly to the resulting HTML tag.

additionalParams.description: Additional query parameters that won't be prefixed like $arguments (overrule $arguments)

arguments.description: Arguments for the controller action, associative array (do not use reserved keywords "action", "controller" or "format" if not referring to these internal variables specifically)

argumentsToBeExcludedFromQueryString.description: Arguments to be removed from the URI. Only active if $addQueryString = true

aria.description: Additional aria-* attributes. They will each be added with a "aria-" prefix.

controller.description: Target controller. If NULL current controllerName is used

data.description: Additional data-* attributes. They will each be added with a "data-" prefix.

extensionName.description: Target Extension Name (without `tx_` prefix and no underscores). If NULL the current extension name is used

language.description: link to a specific language - defaults to the current language, use a language ID or "current" to enforce a specific language

linkAccessRestrictedPages.description: If set, links pointing to access restricted pages will still link to the page even though the page cannot be accessed.

noCache.description: Set this to disable caching for the target page. You should not need this.

pageType.description: Type of the target page. See typolink.parameter

pluginName.description: Target plugin. If empty, the current plugin name is used

section.description: The anchor to be added to the URI

f:link.email.description: ViewHelper to generate an email link (mailto:), respecting TYPO3s spamProtectEmailAddresses TypoScript setting.

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes. They will be added directly to the resulting HTML tag.

aria.description: Additional aria-* attributes. They will each be added with a "aria-" prefix.

bcc.description: The email address(es) for BCC of the email link

body.description: A prefilled body for the email link

cc.description: The email address(es) for CC of the email link

data.description: Additional data-* attributes. They will each be added with a "data-" prefix.

email.description: The email address to be turned into a link

subject.description: A prefilled subject for the email link

f:link.external.description: ViewHelper for creating links to external targets.

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes. They will be added directly to the resulting HTML tag.

aria.description: Additional aria-* attributes. They will each be added with a "aria-" prefix.

data.description: Additional data-* attributes. They will each be added with a "data-" prefix.

defaultScheme.description: Scheme the href attribute will be prefixed with if specified $uri does not contain a scheme already

uri.description: The URI that will be put in the href attribute of the rendered link tag

download.description: Specifies if file should be downloaded instead of displayed

filename.description: Specifies an alternative filename. If filename contains a file extension, this must be the same as from 'file'.

absolute.description: Ensure the resulting URL is an absolute URL

addQueryString.description: If set, the current query parameters will be kept in the URL. If set to "untrusted", then ALL query parameters will be added. Be aware, that this might lead to problems when the generated link is cached.

addQueryStringExclude.description: Define parameters to be excluded from the query string (only active if addQueryString is set)

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes to be added directly to the resulting HTML tag

additionalParams.description: Additional query parameters to be attached to the resulting URL

class.description: Define classes for the link element

language.description: link to a specific language - defaults to the current language, use a language ID or "current" to enforce a specific language

partsAs.description: Variable name containing typoLink parts (if any), defaults to "typoLinkParts"

target.description: Define where to display the linked URL

textWrap.description: Wrap the link using the typoscript "wrap" data type

title.description: Define the title for the link element

f:max.description: The MaxViewHelper returns the maximum element from an array

f:media.description: ViewHelper to render a given media file (audio/video/images) with the correct HTML tag.

additionalAttributes.description: Additional tag attributes. They will be added directly to the resulting HTML tag.

additionalConfig.description: This array can hold additional configuration that is passed though to the Renderer object

aria.description: Additional aria-* attributes. They will each be added with a "aria-" prefix.

cropVariant.description: select a cropping variant, in case multiple croppings have been specified or stored in FileReference

data.description: Additional data-* attributes. They will each be added with a "data-" prefix.

decoding.description: Provides an image decoding hint to the browser. Can be "sync", "async" or "auto"

fileExtension.description: Custom file extension to use for images

height.description: This can be a numeric value representing the fixed height in pixels. But you can also perform simple calculations by adding "m" or "c" to the value. See imgResource.width for possible options.

loading.description: Native lazy-loading for images property. Can be "lazy", "eager" or "auto". Used on image files only.

width.description: This can be a numeric value representing the fixed width of in pixels. But you can also perform simple calculations by adding "m" or "c" to the value. See imgResource.width for possible options.

f:merge.description: The MergeViewHelper merges two arrays into one, optionally recursively.

f:min.description: The MinViewHelper returns the minimum element from an array.

arguments.description: Arguments to be replaced in the resulting string, using sprintf

f:page.footerData.description: The <f:page.footerData> ViewHelper allows injecting arbitrary content right before the closing </body> tag of a rendered page.

f:page.headerData.description: The <f:page.headerData> ViewHelper allows injecting arbitrary content into the HTML <head> of a rendered page.

f:page.meta.description: The Fluid ViewHelper <f:page.meta> allows meta tags to be defined directly within Fluid templates by leveraging TYPO3's MetaTagManager API.

replace.description: Replace existing meta tags with the same property

subProperties.description: Array of sub-properties for complex meta tags (e.g. og:image width/height)

type.description: The meta type attribute (name, property, http-equiv). If not set, the appropriate manager will determine the type.

f:page.title.description: The ViewHelper allows setting the page title directly from Fluid templates.

f:range.description: The RangeViewHelper returns an array containing a range of integers.

end.description: Last possible value of the sequence.

step.description: indicates by how much the produced sequence is progressed between values of the sequence.

f:render.description: A ViewHelper to render a section, a partial, a specified section in a partial or a delegate ParsedTemplateInterface implementation.

arguments.description: Array of variables to be transferred. Use {_all} for all variables

contentAs.description: If used, renders the child content and adds it as a template variable with this name for use in the partial/section

debug.description: If true, the admin panel shows debug information if activated,

default.description: Value (usually string) to be displayed if the section or partial does not exist

delegate.description: Optional PHP class name of a permanent, included-in-app ParsedTemplateInterface implementation to override partial/section

optional.description: If true, considers the *section* optional. Partial never is.

partial.description: Partial to render, with or without section

section.description: Section to render - combine with partial to render section in partial

f:render.contentArea.description: This ViewHelper can be used to render a content area provided by the page-content data processor.

contentArea.description: A content area from the page-content processor

recordAs.description: Name of the variable to store the current record in, if you want to use it in the before/after content.

f:render.record.description: This ViewHelper renders a record object via its TypoScript definition. The most common use case is rendering a content element that is available as a record object in a Fluid template.

f:render.text.description: ViewHelper to render content based on records and fields from a TCA schema. Handles the processing of both simple and rich text fields. By default, accessing a missing field raises an error. Set optional to true to return null instead.

field.description: The database field that should be rendered (even if extbase model is used).

optional.description: If the provided field does not exist in the record, null will be returned.

record.description: A Record API Object or extbase model

f:replace.description: The ReplaceViewHelper replaces one or multiple strings with other strings. This ViewHelper mimicks PHP's str_replace() function. However, it's also possible to provide replace pairs as associative array via the "replace" argument.

f:resource.description: ViewHelper for creating system resource objects.

identifier.description: The resource identifier given as argument or child

f:round.description: The RoundViewHelper rounds a float value with the specified precision and rounding mode. The ViewHelper mimics PHP's round() function.

value.description: The number that should be rounded

f:sanitize.html.description: ViewHelper to pass a given content through typo3/html-sanitizer to mitigate potential cross-site scripting occurrences. The build option by default uses the class TYPO3\CMS\Core\Html\DefaultSanitizerBuilder, which declares allowed HTML tags, attributes and their values.

build.description: preset name or class-like name of sanitization builder

f:section.description: A ViewHelper to declare sections in templates for later use with e.g. the f:render ViewHelper.

f:security.ifAuthenticated.description: ViewHelper implementing an ifAuthenticated/else condition for frontend users.

else.description: Value to be returned if the condition if not met.

then.description: Value to be returned if the condition if met.

f:security.ifHasRole.description: ViewHelper implementing an ifHasRole/else condition for frontend groups.

else.description: Value to be returned if the condition if not met.

role.description: The usergroup (either the usergroup uid or its title).

then.description: Value to be returned if the condition if met.

f:security.nonce.description: The {f:security.nonce()} ViewHelper generates a CSP (Content Security Policy) nonce and registers it for inclusion in the CSP header.

f:shuffle.description: The ShuffleViewHelper shuffles elements from an array. This ViewHelper uses PHP's shuffle() function.

f:slot.description: f:slot allows a template that is called as a component to access and render the child content of the calling component tag. This makes nesting of components possible.

name.description: Name of the slot, can be omitted for default slot

f:split.description: The SplitViewHelper splits a string by the specified separator, which results in an array. The number of values in the resulting array can be limited with the limit parameter, which results in an array where the last item contains the remaining unsplit string.

limit.description: If limit is positive, a maximum of $limit items will be returned. If limit is negative, all items except for the last $limit items will be returned. 0 will be treated as 1.

f:startsWith.description: StartsWith ViewHelper checks if the subject string starts with a specified string. This ViewHelper implements an if/else condition.

else.description: Value to be returned if the condition if not met.

search.description: String to search in subject at the beginning

then.description: Value to be returned if the condition if met.

f:switch.description: Switch ViewHelper which can be used to render content depending on a value or expression. Implements what a basic PHP switch() does.

f:then.description: f:then only has an effect inside of f:if. See the f:if ViewHelper for documentation.

f:transform.html.description: ViewHelper to transform HTML and substitute internal link scheme aspects.

selector.description: comma separated list of node attributes to be considered

languageKey.description: Language key ("da" for example) or "en" to use. Also a Locale object is possible. If empty, use current locale from the request.
